prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 35 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1313; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear impact collision while turning left, reporting neck and low back pain with associated stiffness and headaches. Initial examination showed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness consistent with soft tissue strain, and the mechanism of injury is consistent with the symptoms described. Neurological screening, reflexes, and strength were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar regions is documented in available records. Over the course of care, the patient completed 35 visits, including physical therapy, chiropractic manipulation, and massage therapy, with additional modalities added over successive months. Treatment intensity and duration have exceeded what is typically expected for a cervical and lumbar strain of this type. Billing records reflect distinct services with no duplicate charges. Continued conservative care with a home exercise program and reassessment of functional goals is recommended, with discharge planning to follow once the patient reaches a stable plateau.
